topic: Late-invoice reminders that get freelancers paid without awkward emails (fictional business — example)

facts.name: Payloop
facts.price: Free for 3 clients; Pro $12 per month for unlimited clients; VAT not included
facts.claim: Sends polite payment reminders on the schedule you choose and stops the moment an invoice is marked paid
facts.howItWorks: Connect your invoicing tool, pick a reminder schedule, watch paid status update automatically
facts.audience: Freelancers and small agencies chasing late invoices
facts.action: Start the free plan and connect your invoicing tool
facts.changelog: 2026-09-18 Reminders pause when a client replies https://example.com/changelog/pause-on-reply ; 2026-08-25 Choose a quiet-hours window https://example.com/changelog/quiet-hours ; 2026-07-28 Export reminder history as CSV https://example.com/changelog/csv-export
facts.usageLimit: Free plan: up to 3 clients. Pro plan: unlimited clients
facts.integrations: Calendar | https://example.com/integrations/calendar | native ; Messenger | https://example.com/integrations/messenger | webhook ; Accounting | https://example.com/integrations/accounting | api
facts.testimonials: Mina Park | Freelance illustrator | Studio Mina | Late invoices dropped from five a month to one after I turned on the reminders ; Daniel Cho | Founder | Cho Design Lab | I stopped writing awkward follow-up emails because the reminders go out on their own
facts.faq: Can I try it for free? | Yes, the free plan covers 3 clients and Pro has a 14-day trial without a card ; Will clients get rude emails? | No, every reminder is polite and you choose the schedule ; What happens when an invoice is paid? | Reminders stop right away
